report_name: Osaka University Crippled by Ransomware Attack

attack_patterns.name: Phishing
attack_patterns.description: Used as a likely initial access vector to gain entry into the university's network.

attack_patterns.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
attack_patterns.description: The final stage of the attack where a ransomware payload was deployed to encrypt files on approximately 500 servers.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
attack_patterns.description: Sensitive data was likely exfiltrated before encryption to be used for double extortion tactics.

attack_patterns.name: SMB/Windows Admin Shares
attack_patterns.description: Used for lateral movement across the network to compromise a large number of systems, including 500 servers.

attack_patterns.name: Inhibit System Recovery
attack_patterns.description: Attackers likely deleted volume shadow copies using 'wmic.exe shadowcopy delete' to prevent easy system recovery, a common ransomware precursor.

attack_patterns.name: Create Account
attack_patterns.description: Suspicious account creation (Windows Security Event ID 4720) was noted as a hunting hint, suggesting attackers may create accounts for persistence.

attack_patterns.name: Permission Groups Discovery
attack_patterns.description: Attackers likely performed reconnaissance of privileged accounts using commands like 'net group "Domain Admins" /domain' to identify targets for privilege escalation.

tools.name: PsExec
tools.description: The remote administration tool PsExec or its variants were likely used for lateral movement and to deploy payloads across the 500 affected servers.

tools.name: wmic
tools.description: The wmic.exe utility was used to delete volume shadow copies to inhibit system recovery, as indicated by the command line pattern 'wmic.exe shadowcopy delete'.

campaigns.name: Osaka Metropolitan University Ransomware Attack
campaigns.description: A major suspected ransomware attack against Osaka Metropolitan University in October 2026, affecting 500 servers and potentially compromising data for 130,000 individuals.
campaigns.objective: Disrupt university operations and extort a ransom through data encryption and threatened data leakage.

identities.name: Osaka Metropolitan University
identities.description: A large public university in Japan that was the victim of a major ransomware attack affecting 500 servers and the personal data of 130,000 individuals.

indicators.name: Ransomware Reconnaissance - Domain Admin Discovery
indicators.pattern:
title: Ransomware Reconnaissance - Domain Admin Discovery
id: 7e8b1c2a-3d4e-4f5a-8b9c-0d1e2f3a4b5c
status: experimental
description: Detects the use of 'net.exe' to enumerate members of the 'Domain Admins' group, a common reconnaissance technique used by ransomware operators.
references:
  - https://research.checkpoint.com/2026/12th-october-threat-intelligence-report/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-10-13
tags:
  - attack.t1069.002
level: medium
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\net.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'group'
      - 'Domain Admins'
      - '/domain'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the execution of 'net group "Domain Admins" /domain', a command frequently used by attackers for reconnaissance.

indicators.name: Ransomware Lateral Movement - PsExec Usage
indicators.pattern:
title: Ransomware Lateral Movement - PsExec Usage
id: 8f9c2d3b-4e5f-4a6b-9c0d-1e2f3a4b5c6d
status: experimental
description: Detects the execution of PsExec or its variants, which are commonly used by ransomware attackers for lateral movement and remote code execution.
references:
  - https://research.checkpoint.com/2026/12th-october-threat-intelligence-report/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-10-13
tags:
  - attack.t1021.002
  - attack.t1570
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    OriginalFileName:
      - 'psexec.exe'
      - 'paexec.exe'
    Image|endswith:
      - '\psexec.exe'
      - '\paexec.exe'
  condition: 1 of selection
indicators.description: Detects the use of PsExec.exe or paexec.exe, strong indicators of lateral movement in a ransomware attack.

indicators.name: Ransomware Defense Evasion - Shadow Copy Deletion
indicators.pattern:
title: Ransomware Defense Evasion - Shadow Copy Deletion
id: 9a0d3e4c-5f6a-4b7c-8d1e-2f3a4b5c6d7e
status: experimental
description: Detects the use of wmic.exe to delete volume shadow copies, a common ransomware tactic to inhibit system recovery.
references:
  - https://research.checkpoint.com/2026/12th-october-threat-intelligence-report/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-10-13
tags:
  - attack.t1490
level: critical
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\wmic.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'shadowcopy'
      - 'delete'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the command 'wmic.exe shadowcopy delete' used to prevent system restoration.

indicators.name: Ransomware Persistence - Suspicious Account Creation
indicators.pattern:
title: Ransomware Persistence - Suspicious Account Creation
id: a1b2c3d4-6a7b-4c8d-9e2f-3a4b5c6d7e8f
status: experimental
description: Detects the creation of a new user account, which can be an indicator of an attacker creating a persistence mechanism.
references:
  - https://research.checkpoint.com/2026/12th-october-threat-intelligence-report/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-10-13
tags:
  - attack.t1136
level: medium
logsource:
  product: windows
  service: security
detection:
  selection:
    EventID: 4720
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the creation of a user account (Event ID 4720), which could be used by attackers for persistence.

indicators.name: Ransomware Note File Creation
indicators.x_netsecio_sigma_rule:
title: Ransomware Note File Creation
id: b2c3d4e5-7b8c-4d9e-8f3a-4b5c6d7e8f9a
status: experimental
description: Detects the creation of a file named 'ransom.txt', a common indicator of a ransomware infection.
references:
  - https://research.checkpoint.com/2026/12th-october-threat-intelligence-report/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-10-13
tags:
  - attack.t1486
level: critical
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|endswith: '\ransom.txt'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the creation of a file named 'ransom.txt', which is a common artifact left by ransomware after encryption.
